name: FFS_CATALOG_SCM_SYNC
description: Manages the synchronization process between Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Oracle Field Service (OFS).

columns.name: CATALOG_SCM_ID
columns.description: Reference to the corresponding FFS_CATALOG_SCM, associating each sync process with the right catalog integration setup.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Type of the synchronization process, such as 'CURR' or 'PREV'.

columns.name: SYNC_SCHEDULED_AT
columns.description: Timestamp indicating when a synchronization process is scheduled to start.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the synchronization process, such as 'SYNCED', 'ERROR', or 'SYNCING'.

columns.name: SYNC_STARTED_AT
columns.description: Timestamp marking the start of the synchronization process.

columns.name: SYNC_FINISHED_AT
columns.description: Timestamp marking the end of the synchronization process.

columns.name: TOTAL_ITEMS
columns.description: Numeric field indicating the total number of items expected to be processed in the sync.

columns.name: PROCESSED_ITEMS
columns.description: Count of items that have been processed in the ongoing synchronization iteration, indicating sync progress.

columns.name: CATALOG_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Version of the catalog created during the sync iteration.

columns.name: SYNC_TRACE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the sync process, instrumental in tracking and investigating operations. Also associated with corresponding log entries.

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Error code provided when a sync process ends with an error.

columns.name: ERROR_DESC
columns.description: Detailed description of the error encountered during the sync process.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_DATA
columns.description: Additional not standardized JSON data of the sync process.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
